text:
margaret: Heads-up — reporter from TechCrunch just pinged for a quick quote on the benchmark blog we pushed ~10m ago. They want a plain-language line about latency/cost tradeoffs and confirmation of the test harness. Who can own a 1-2 sentence quote? :eyes:
press_ops: I can take the handoff. Do we have an approved quote bank or do we need legal sign-off?
amy_legal: Quick check — if the quote mentions comparative numbers or claims, I need to sign off. If it's high level (product vision or process), we can do it fast.
josh_eng: I can confirm the harness and the numbers. TL;DR: end-to-end P99 measured on Dedicated with tokenized workload, quantization config q4f16, no KV-cache.
margaret: OK press_ops please ask reporter to hold for ~20-30m while we confirm quote + legal. If they insist on publishing tonight, offer this interim note: "We stand by our benchmarks; we'll follow up with a detailed methods note."
press_ops: Pinged reporter asking for a 30m window. Also asked if they need embargo — they said no, it's live. Can we push an official note to our media queue if they publish?
sophie_social: If they go live, we should have a short social-ready quote. Suggestion from product side: "Redwood Inference reduces per-token latency and cost by optimizing batching and cache policies for production workloads." Shorter options welcome.
ajosh_eng: Edited to tighten technical accuracy: "Redwood Inference prioritizes production latency and unit economics by adaptive batching, KV-prefix caching, and quantization-aware kernels."
amy_legal: Approve the shorter social quote as long as it doesn't assert a percent advantage or unnamed comparative claims.
press-monitor-bot: New external mention detected: TechCrunch article draft linked — https://tcrunch.example/bench-preview (monitoring) :mag:
press_ops: Good catch. Margaret — can you approve the final one-liner for outreach? We need a single sentence for the reporter and a separate friendly version for social.
margaret: Go with Josh's technical line for the reporter and Sophie's shorter line for social. Final reporter quote (approved): "At Redwood, we tune the serving runtime — adaptive batching, KV-prefix caching, and quantization-aware kernels — to keep production latency and unit costs low for real-world apps."
press_ops: Sending quote to reporter now. Copying the social team for live updates.
sophie_social: Working draft social copy: ```New from Redwood: production-focused benchmarks showing how smarter batching and caching cut latency + cost for LLM workloads. Read more: shorturl.example/bench``` Can someone confirm shortened link?
margaret: Use shorturl.example/bench for now. If legal flags anything, we'll update.
amy_legal: No issues with that phrasing.
press_ops: Reporter confirmed they will include the quote and sent a planned pull-quote screenshot. I'll add this thread to the media tracker. :thumbsup:
press-monitor-bot: External publication detected: TechCrunch published article — https://tcrunch.example/bench (tracking) :rocket:
press_ops: Great — social team, prepare to amplify. Marketing ops, add to press highlights doc.
sophie_social: On it. I'll queue the social post at T+5 and coordinate with the organic channels.
margaret: Thanks team. Quick retrospective: let's add a faster small-quote legal approval flow for these same-day pickups. I'll spin up a one-pager tomorrow. :memo:
